title_zh: 一张旧纸条让他破防了
title_en: New Slang, New Stories (6/20): The Old Note That Broke Him
note_en: 刚……就…… means "no sooner ... than ...": 刚说出"谢谢你"三个字，声音就有点发抖 "he had barely said 'thank you' when his voice started to shake." English needs a whole construction ("as soon as," "barely ... when"), but Chinese just puts 刚 before the first verb and 就 before the second.
